Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 104. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have practiced techniques in melee combat against
spellcasters, gaining the following benefits.
When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell,
you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon
attack against that creature.
When you damage a creature that is concentrating
on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the
saving throw it makes to maintain its concentration.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells
cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.
